# gtk4 writes a program in C, which `sngl build` compiles with the host's C
# compiler, linking GTK through the pkg-config its sngl.build names. It needs
# no display.

[!exec:pkg-config] skip 'pkg-config required'
[!exec:cc] skip 'C compiler required'
[!gtk4] skip 'gtk4 development libraries required'

sngl build --platform=gtk4 --lang=c app.sngl -o out
[toolchain] exists out/app

# A generic component built at run time is copied per type, and its method
# takes the copy as its `this`, which C names as the record the method is
# written in.

sngl build --platform=gtk4 --lang=c generic.sngl -o out/generic
[toolchain] exists out/generic/app

# An update reactivity places in two bodies is one expression both share, of
# which NoRef rewrites each read of a box once.

sngl build --platform=gtk4 --lang=c shared.sngl -o out/shared
[toolchain] exists out/shared/app

# A page a loop copies is told apart by the indices of its copy, a list.

sngl build --platform=gtk4 --lang=c pages.sngl -o out/pages
[toolchain] exists out/pages/app

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

component counter ui.node {
    var n = 0
    ui.button(text="{n}", @click {
        n += 1
    })
}

ui.window(title="count") {
    counter()
}
-- generic.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

output {
    none {
        html
    }
    go {
        fyne
        gtk4
    }
    kotlin {
        android
    }
}

component show[T any](
    xs list[T],
    w  struct {
        v T
    },
    @chose(w struct {
        v T
    }),
) {
    var held = w
    var hits = 0
    func boxed() struct {
        v T
    } {
        return {v=held.v}
    }
    ui.button(text="{hits} {xs.length}", @click {
        hits = hits + 1
        held = boxed()
        chose(held)
    })
}

// Held under an `if`, so it is built at run time.
component held[T any](:value T, next T) {
    var hits = 0
    ui.button(text="{hits}", @click {
        hits += 1
        value = next
    })
}

var items = [1, 2]
var names = ["a", "b"]
var got = 0
var said = ""
var shown = true
var n = 0

ui.window(title="x") {
    for var i = items {
        show(xs=[i], w={v=i}, @chose(w) { got = w.v })
    }
    for var s = names {
        show(xs=[s], w={v=s}, @chose(w) { said = w.v })
    }
    if shown {
        held(:value=n, next=4)
    }
}
-- shared.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

output {
    none {
        html
    }
    go {
        bubbletea
        fyne
        gtk4
    }
    kotlin {
        android
    }
}

var n = 1

func at[T any](xs list[T]) T {
    var i = n
    if i >= xs.length {
        i = 0
    }
    return xs[i]
}

func count[T any](xs list[T], want T) int {
    var c = 0
    for var x = xs {
        if x == want {
            c += 1
        }
    }
    return c
}

func both[T any](xs list[T], want T) int {
    var c = count(xs, want)
    return c + count([at(xs)], want)
}

func last[T any](xs list[T]) T {
    var i = xs.length - 1
    return xs[i]
}

func pad[T any](xs list[T], extra list[T] = []) int {
    var c = xs.length + extra.length
    return c + n
}

func blank[T any]() list[T] {
    var out list[T] = []
    if n < 0 {
        return out
    }
    return out
}

component box {
    var k = 0
    func nth[T any](xs list[T]) T {
        var i = k
        return xs[i]
    }
    ui.text(value="{nth([1, 2])} {nth(["a", "b"])}")
    ui.button(text="k", @click {
        k = 1
    })
}

var xs = [10, 20, 10]
var names = ["a", "b"]
var e list[string] = ["z"]
var fns = last([
    func(x int) string {
        return "{x}"
    },
])
var acts = last([
    func(x int, s string) {
        n = x
    },
])

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value="{both(xs, 10)} {both(names, "b")} {e.length} {pad([1])} {fns(1)}")
    box()
    ui.button(text="go", @click {
        n = 2
        e = blank()
        acts(1, "s")
    })
}
-- pages.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

output {
    go {
        gtk4
        fyne
        bubbletea
    }
    kotlin {
        android
    }
}

struct Row {
    name string
    cols list[string]
}

struct Sel {
    pick string
}

const rows list[Row] = [
    {name="a", cols=["1", "2"]},
    {name="b", cols=["3"]},
]

component grid ui.node {
    nav.stack #pages {
        for var r = rows {
            for var c = r.cols {
                nav.page #cell(href=c == "3" ? "/" : "/" + r.name + "/" + c, title=r.name + c, params=Sel{pick=c}) {
                    component content(s) {
                        ui.text #line(value="{r.name} {c} picked {s.pick}")
                        ui.text(value=pages.current == cell ? "showing" : "hidden")
                        ui.button #pick(text="pick", @click { pages.go(cell, Sel{pick="x"}) })
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        nav.page #about(href="/about", title="About") {
            ui.text(value="about")
        }
    }
    ui.text #heading(value=pages.current.title)
    ui.button #toAbout(text="About", @click { pages.go(about) })
    ui.button #back(text="Back", @click { pages.back() })
}

ui.window(title="Grid") {
    grid
}
